intent: The field's cards take the token border, and the this-is-not-the-whole-field sentence takes the notice role — the precedent treatment for the 67-box sweep (#155).
rationale: The field cards wear bare 'rounded border' — Tailwind's 4px radius and default grey, neither a token, the input defect control.ts documents surviving on boxes. The tokened spelling the newer surfaces wear (rounded-gc-2, border.default) is the decision; this ticket states it once on the surface with the most cards, so the mechanical sweep (#155) executes a decided treatment instead of deciding one per file. The partial-field sentence is this page's load-bearing honesty — 'BattleGrid counts N but returned M; this is not the whole field' is the difference between a partial view and a wrong one — and it currently has the weight of a caption; it takes notice (advisory, never danger: nothing failed, the platform under-returned). The win-rate caveat stays plain secondary prose — it is a reading instruction, not an event.

design.layout: Unchanged — heading, form, caveats, card list, vendors.

cards.content: Each card: 1px color.border.default border, radius.2, existing space.3 padding and vertical rhythm unchanged. No background change — the lift is the themed border, not a panel. This is the precedent treatment for #155's sweep.

empty.content: Unchanged — 'BattleGrid returned no agents for this window', plain prose.

partial-field.content: The sentence takes the notice role: color.notice.subtle background, 1px color.notice.border border, radius.2, space.4 padding, color.text.primary. Advisory, never danger — the platform under-returned; nothing failed.

win-rate-caveat.content: Unchanged in role — stays plain prose, demoted to color.text.secondary so a standing reading instruction does not compete with the notice above it.

responsive.mobile: Cards full width; nothing else moves.

acceptance: Every field card wears border color.border.default at radius.2 — 'rounded border' appears nowhere in app/(app)/explorer/page.tsx
The partial-field sentence renders in a notice block (color.notice.subtle / color.notice.border) and never in danger
The win-rate caveat renders in color.text.secondary as plain prose
Zero copy changes anywhere on the page
Rates still render 'not measured' when absent, and every rate keeps its trade count beside it
No raw color, spacing, or size literal is introduced

references.value: Backlog #155 — this ticket is the precedent its mechanical sweep executes. Backlog #108 gap 2, fourth surface pass.
